knowledgeTool.title: Knowledge search tool (MCP)
knowledgeTool.subtitle: How the agent-facing read-only search tool is launched. Leave blank to use the built-in server — most setups never need to change this.
knowledgeTool.transportNote: The transport is always stdio (a process pipe): no port is opened and no network traffic is produced, so it is unaffected by VPNs, system proxies and firewalls, and it does not disturb your other MCP servers.
knowledgeTool.serverNameHint: MCP server name registered with the agent. Blank uses {{name}}. A server you already have under the same name would collide.
knowledgeTool.commandHint: Blank uses the built-in server. Setting it takes over launching entirely, so provide the arguments too.
knowledgeTool.argsHint: Space separated. Editable only when an executable is set.
knowledgeTool.envHint: One KEY=VALUE per line. The index and audit paths are injected automatically; set them here only to override. Do not put secrets here.

handoff.title: Cross-agent handoff
handoff.description: The handoff package contains only this project's plan, tasks and project memory. API keys, raw execution logs and other projects never enter it. Confirming starts a new session and hands the text below to the new agent.
handoff.targetHint: A new agent cannot pick up the old agent's session, so a handoff always starts a new session.
handoff.previewHint: Edit freely — what you leave here is exactly what gets injected.
handoff.kickoff: Read the handoff package above. First restate your understanding of the current progress and constraints, then say what you intend to do next. Do not start working yet.
handoff.migrated: Handed off. The package was injected into a new session.
